test_assertion: Proposed: changing a mapping learned after origin does not alter origin snapshot; pre/post-transfer future spend reaches respective teams and company total is unchanged.
residual_limit: Future organizational plans can change; mapping scenarios need probabilities or explicit nonprobabilistic labels.
requirement_source: master plan source dates and coverage; backend history; Factory current versus superseded plans

scenario: Company invoice is complete, two team feeds are missing, and a shared API key has no owner.
mechanism: Missing feeds become zero or invoice residual is arbitrarily distributed to force totals.
detection: Compare coverage scopes, service windows, currency and charge categories; keep unknown/shared distinct from unavailable.
response: Preserve explicit unattributed/shared amounts; publish incomplete partition or a comparable-basis residual; abstain from fabricated team totals.
test_assertion: Proposed: absent feed never becomes observed zero; coherent complete company forecast is not mislabeled as complete team coverage.
residual_limit: A complete company bill does not identify its team decomposition.
requirement_source: master plan §2 measured/estimated/reported categories; backend incomplete data checks

scenario: A seven-day forecast spans October and November while a monthly view assigns the whole week to October.
mechanism: Weekly and calendar-month periods are falsely treated as nested; truncated horizon silently accepted.
detection: Compare explicit date sets and interval bounds, timezone, and path coverage.
response: Use date-incidence rows; sum exact local-date membership; mark insufficient path coverage unavailable.
test_assertion: Proposed: Oct 30–Nov 5 allocates two daily amounts to October and five to November; no date is omitted or duplicated.
residual_limit: Intraday cutoffs and late service-date records require separate nowcast policy.
owner: forecast target compiler + backend time semantics
requirement_source: master plan shared forecast target periods; research brief cumulative 7/14/30 and month remainder

scenario: Hundreds of intermittent person/tool series have few complete residual origins and one common rollout shock.
mechanism: Sample covariance is singular/noisy; pairwise missing-data estimates may be incompatible; estimated MinT weights become extreme.
detection: Check aligned residual support, rank/conditioning, PSD, weight magnitude, and rolling error after structural change.
response: Compare variance WLS and shrinkage; reduce partition or exclude poor bases; fallback on numerical failure.
test_assertion: Proposed: finite coherent outputs or explicit fallback, never NaNs/inf; fallback reason and covariance sample provenance retained.
residual_limit: Numerical stability does not demonstrate accuracy; shrinkage cannot remove unknown bias.
requirement_source: master plan unavailable forecasts and evidence; numerical-method research remit

scenario: Gross charges and a legitimate refund are reconciled with a global nonnegative flag.
mechanism: Nonnegativity erases credits or independent per-level clipping breaks additivity.
detection: Check component semantic sign rules and coherence before/after constraints.
response: Reconcile nonnegative gross usage/charges separately from signed credits; derive net totals; use constrained solve rather than unrelated clipping.
test_assertion: Proposed: legitimate negative net cost survives; gross samples obey intended nonnegativity; every retained aggregation identity holds within tolerance.
residual_limit: Refund timing/dispute outcomes may lack forecastable history.
requirement_source: master plan distinct cost categories and units; financial-basis requirement

scenario: Daily Normality samples are cross-sectionally coherent but each horizon is independently sampled before a 30-day risk calculation.
mechanism: Cross-time covariance is lost, producing unjustified cumulative tails despite coherent daily totals.
detection: Inspect sampler capability and path metadata; evaluate cumulative target calibration and joint residual dependence.
response: Use validated joint paths or direct cumulative calibration; expose uncertainty unavailable otherwise.
test_assertion: Proposed: cumulative distributions sum complete path IDs before quantiles; sampler without temporal dependence cannot claim validated 30-day risk merely from daily coherence.
residual_limit: Unknown common-shock dependence remains a modeling risk even with path IDs.
requirement_source: master plan supported uncertainty; brief cumulative forecasts; HierarchicalForecast v1.5.3 source

scenario: UI adds research and product P95 values to display a company P95.
mechanism: Marginal quantiles are treated as additive statistics.
detection: Schema distinguishes mean, quantile and joint sample; aggregation operator checks statistic type.
response: Aggregate complete joint draws or request a directly calibrated company distribution.
test_assertion: Proposed exact fixture: independent $100 Bernoulli(0.04) team costs have marginal P95=0 but company P95=100; quantile-summing request is rejected.
residual_limit: Marginals alone cannot reconstruct joint distribution or dependence.
requirement_source: master plan forecast quantity/uncertainty handoff; probabilistic reconciliation requirement

scenario: Grouped person×project data requests PERMBU; nonnegative MinTrace requests bootstrap intervals; stale FoReco docs configure old arguments.
mechanism: Method topology/probability restrictions and version drift are hidden behind a generic reconciler API.
detection: Versioned capability registry and preflight validation against matrix topology, interval method, dependency pin.
response: Reject unsupported combinations with an explicit alternative; verify supported adapters with small algebraic fixtures before promotion.
test_assertion: Proposed: unsupported request cannot silently degrade to independent or negative samples; package/version/capability recorded in output provenance.
residual_limit: Static source review is not runtime verification; fit and sample entry paths can differ.
requirement_source: implementation-library research remit; supported uncertainty and unavailable-state handoffs

scenario: Observed month-to-date charges plus fixed fees exceed a manager budget used as an immutable total, while future gross spend is constrained nonnegative.
mechanism: A planning allocation is mistaken for an accounting identity or spending cap, yielding infeasibility or rewritten actuals.
detection: Classify immutable facts versus forecasts versus internal allocations; check feasibility before solving.
response: Keep observed amounts unchanged; remove budget as forecast equality; report forecast overrun or invalid constraints.
test_assertion: Proposed: recorded actuals never change through reconciliation; internal budget is compared with forecast, not imposed as total; infeasible genuine constraints return an error.
residual_limit: Historical charges may be revised by source; versioned corrections remain distinct from reconciliation.
owner: backend financial state + forecast constraint compiler
requirement_source: master plan §1 internal budgets do not enforce provider usage; §§2–4 category and ownership boundaries

scenario: A 30-day cumulative label starts before the fold origin but ends after it; billing also settles late.
mechanism: Future outcomes enter training despite chronological origin sorting.
detection: Assert target_end <= fold_origin and label_available_at <= fold_origin.
response: Purge labels by exact maturity; preserve as-of feature snapshots.
test_assertion: Injected overlapping and late-finalized labels are excluded; later revisions cannot change the original fold snapshot.
residual_limit: Maturity can sharply reduce recent eligible data.
requirement_source: Master plan §2 evidence distinction; backend coverage handoff; mentor lines 35–40 representativeness

scenario: Employee moves teams after origin; current mapping rewrites earlier team history and encodings.
mechanism: Future organizational knowledge changes labels, exposure and identity statistics.
detection: Check effective/known-at mapping intervals and snapshot hashes.
response: Use historical attribution contract; label restated-history evaluation separately.
test_assertion: Mapping known only after T leaves all as-of-T features unchanged; restated reporting remains separate.
residual_limit: Ambiguity can require unallocated series or unavailable forecast.
requirement_source: Master plan §2 explicit mapping; mentor line 54 headcount

scenario: New team and new model appear during a collector gap; unseen categories route as missing.
mechanism: A finite prediction hides unsupported identity and incomplete coverage.
detection: Track unseen categories, history length and independent completeness.
response: Use eligible metadata/exposure fallback and distinct cold-start/incomplete states.
test_assertion: Unseen ID with complete collection is marked cold-start; with incomplete collection it cannot silently return ordinary-confidence output.
residual_limit: No fallback recovers unknown adoption volume.
requirement_source: Master plan §§2–3 provenance/availability; mentor lines 46–49 adoption

scenario: Sparse matrix conversion omits true zero usage while zero_as_missing configuration changes.
mechanism: Observed inactivity becomes missingness or vice versa and shifts routes.
detection: Version matrix representation/missing policy and compare dense/sparse equivalence.
response: Keep explicit coverage flags and consistent zero semantics across fit/serve.
test_assertion: Complete equivalent dense/sparse rows produce equivalent features/predictions; collector-missing rows remain distinct from zero.
residual_limit: Native NaN handling cannot fix upstream semantics.
requirement_source: Master plan §2 completeness and usage evidence

scenario: Research spending grows 100x while small teams have near-zero historical scale.
mechanism: Squared loss ignores small teams; inverse-scale weighting lets tiny denominators dominate.
detection: Report company-weighted/team-balanced metrics and scale/weight distributions.
response: Compare raw and origin-normalized loss with declared floor/cap and slice gates.
test_assertion: Zero histories yield finite weights; huge-team addition cannot remove small-team evaluation; slice-gate failure rejects candidate.
residual_limit: Finance must choose priorities; no universal weighting optimum.
requirement_source: Master plan §§1,3 company/team comparisons; mentor company heterogeneity

scenario: Reported variable cost contains negative refunds and enormous token counts mislabeled as currency.
mechanism: Tweedie/Poisson support fails, mixed units distort fitting, large labels overflow.
detection: Enforce target category/unit/nonnegative/finite domains.
response: Separate adjustments and units; reversible scaling; fail invalid fits.
test_assertion: Negative refund/unit mismatch fails before fit; large valid rescaled target yields finite original-unit output or explicit unavailable state.
residual_limit: Separate adjustment forecast still needs policy.
requirement_source: Master plan §2 usage/estimated/reported cost distinction

scenario: Daily P90 values are summed into month P90 while project bursts correlate days.
mechanism: Marginal quantiles do not add; independent samples omit burst dependence.
detection: Tag marginal/direct-cumulative/joint-scenario output construction.
response: Fit cumulative quantiles or validated joint scenarios and score aggregates.
test_assertion: Aggregation rejects sum of marginal quantiles as calibrated month quantile; correlated synthetic fixture verifies construction distinction only.
residual_limit: Cumulative marginal quantiles do not solve cross-team joint risk.
requirement_source: Master plan §3 uncertainty handoff; mentor requested error rate

scenario: Backtest supplies actual held-out lag values but serving supplies predicted lags.
mechanism: Teacher forcing understates multistep errors.
detection: Instrument recursive-feature lineage.
response: Replay serving recursion using origin data and prior forecasts/simulations.
test_assertion: Replacing held-out actual lag values cannot change an earlier issued forecast; only known future calendar inputs are permitted.
residual_limit: Correct recursion still accumulates error.
requirement_source: Master plan forecast assumptions; transcript backtesting ambition

scenario: Historical low allocations correlate with lower workload; assistant treats SHAP as causal savings.
mechanism: Predictive association is mistaken for intervention effect.
detection: Separate prediction-explanation and causal/scenario result types; track budget-feature use.
response: State association; require explicit workload scenario or causal evidence for intervention estimate.
test_assertion: Importance/SHAP fields cannot become claimed causal savings or authorization to change allocations.
residual_limit: Behavioral feedback remains unobserved.
requirement_source: Master plan §§1,3 internal allocation/approval; frontend proposal distinction

scenario: Short February changes remainder horizon; independently fitted S7/S14/S30 cross.
mechanism: Fixed-30-day shortcut or inconsistent heads misstates planning period.
detection: Check local-calendar boundaries, h=0, quantile order and cumulative monotonicity for nonnegative targets.
response: Use explicit start/end; evaluate coherence postprocessing separately.
test_assertion: At local month end remainder is zero; declared coherence holds or output is flagged, including leap-day fixture.
residual_limit: Postprocessing can harm calibration; negative-net targets are exempt from nonnegative monotonicity.
requirement_source: Master plan §§2–3 period/unit handoff; mentor line 49 horizon utility

scenario: The default MAE-trained neural forecast is displayed as expected spend and used to total a heavy-tailed research workload.
mechanism: Conditional median is mislabeled as mean; adding medians compounds underestimation under skew and price variation.
detection: Artifact metadata records target transform, loss, point functional and aggregation operation; compare mean and median on a known skewed fixture.
response: Expose median separately, train a mean-appropriate objective or derive means from a validated distribution; aggregate the intended functional.
test_assertion: Proposed: loading an MAE-only artifact cannot populate an expected_spend_mean field; aggregation rejects unlabeled point functionals.
residual_limit: Finite-sample estimates may still be biased even with correct objective.
owner: Forecasting numerical model and forecast-contract owners
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 7; 11-S15 through 11-S18

scenario: An approved evaluation plan was superseded after a historical forecast origin; backtests use the final cancellation or realized staffing.
mechanism: Future knowledge leaks through plan features, normalization or overwritten document states, inflating apparent contextual gains.
detection: As-of provenance join checks recorded_at and effective_at independently; replay features from immutable earlier snapshots.
response: Build vintage-aware features and scenarios; train only on facts and plan versions available at origin.
test_assertion: Proposed: adding a document recorded after the origin leaves that origin feature snapshot and forecast unchanged.
residual_limit: Historically complete document vintages may be unavailable, limiting retrospective causal claims.
owner: Backend provenance and forecasting feature owners
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 6; transcripts/internal-team-discussion.txt contextual rolling-forecast discussion

scenario: A context-aware NHITS model is replaced by PatchTST because its generic signature also exposes exogenous arguments.
mechanism: Architecture metadata or signature inspection falsely implies features are consumed; explanation claims context sensitivity for a history-only model.
detection: Pinned capability matrix plus synthetic perturbation test and consumed-feature report.
response: Reject incompatible artifact/input combinations; require an explicit supported model variant or omit contextual numerical claims.
test_assertion: Proposed: requested future-plan features with NeuralForecast v3.3.0 PatchTST produce a capability error before forecast publication.
residual_limit: Feature acceptance does not prove useful influence or generalization.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 6 and 7; 11-S13, 11-S17

scenario: A new project begins during a provider-reporting outage; padded zeros and outage gaps dominate short training windows.
mechanism: Model interprets unobserved usage as inactivity and learns an artificially gentle ramp, narrowing uncertainty.
detection: Separate valid-zero, absent, delayed, padded and not-yet-existing masks; inspect observed fractions by window.
response: Exclude or specially model low-coverage windows; preserve unavailable state or use a calibrated cold-start baseline.
test_assertion: Proposed: replacing an observed zero with an absent-record marker changes coverage and eligibility; absent data never counts as confirmed zero.
residual_limit: Missing-not-at-random behavior can persist despite masks; launch timing may remain unknown.
owner: Backend coverage and forecasting data owners
requirement_source: docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md section 7

scenario: Research personnel move to engineering while a shared API project changes model provider; a pooled model retains stable team-ID embeddings.
mechanism: Ownership and price/usage regime change simultaneously; stale identity patterns contaminate both teams and historical comparability.
detection: Version ownership mappings, channel vocabularies, provider/model mix and regime-change indicators; compare residuals around change dates.
response: Use explicit stable workload definitions or segmented histories, mark unknown categories and compare grouped/local fallback fits.
test_assertion: Proposed: a remapping event never silently rewrites an earlier forecast vintage; model records which attribution basis generated its targets.
residual_limit: Historical behavioral continuity may not be identifiable; sparse new regimes limit retraining.
owner: Backend attribution and forecasting model owners
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md section 2; transcripts/mentor-discussion.txt headcount and adoption discussion

scenario: Research and engineering join one evaluation campaign; separately sampled DeepAR team paths are summed for company exceedance risk.
mechanism: Independent cross-team samples erase shared campaign uncertainty even though each team time path is temporally coherent.
detection: Scenario-dependence audit and aggregate coverage by shared-event periods; compare independent versus shared-event simulation.
response: Use empirically supported joint dependence or explicit shared scenario draws; label remaining independence assumptions.
test_assertion: Proposed: a shared on/off campaign fixture retains company-level covariance and cannot be reduced to an independent sum without a declared assumption.
residual_limit: Rare common shocks cannot be calibrated from little history.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 3 and 7; 11-S01

scenario: Independent cumulative heads predict 7/14/30-day totals and month remainder; a net-charge refund occurs near month-end.
mechanism: Unconstrained heads cross; day-count masks mismatch; a blanket nondecreasing constraint incorrectly suppresses legitimate negative adjustments.
detection: Check target support, exact interval endpoints, calendar timezone and aggregation identities separately for usage versus net charges.
response: Apply cumulative consistency rules only to compatible nonnegative targets; represent refunds separately or use signed-charge semantics.
test_assertion: Proposed: 28/29/30/31-day month fixtures include only requested dates; nonnegative-use totals are ordered, while valid signed refunds are retained.
residual_limit: Statistical quantiles across nested totals need coherent modeling beyond posthoc clipping.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 7

scenario: Finance increases a team allocation after an overspend forecast, and next refresh treats the new allocation as an enforceable usage cap.
mechanism: An endogenous decision variable is learned as a causal spending constraint despite budgets having no provider-enforcement effect.
detection: Feature audit distinguishes internal decisions, actual provider limits and observed usage; replay budget-only changes.
response: Exclude unsupported budget effects from unconditional consumption forecasts or represent them as explicit behavioral scenarios with evidence.
test_assertion: Proposed: changing only an internal allocation cannot imply a provider cap or truncate predicted consumption through an undocumented rule.
residual_limit: Budgets can influence human behavior; estimating that effect requires appropriate data and design.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 1 and 6; no provider execution controls

scenario: A negative-binomial count model is trained on USD cents, then an otherwise equivalent export switches to dollars and includes credits.
mechanism: Treating monetary denomination as natural count changes the observation model; negative refunds violate support.
detection: Artifact target-unit/support validation; currency-scale conversion fixtures; residual and probability-support inspection.
response: Use a justified continuous or compound monetary model, or forecast genuine counts and apply an explicit valuation layer.
test_assertion: Proposed: negative-binomial adapter rejects signed monetary targets absent an explicitly approved generative transformation; currency conversion preserves target semantics.
residual_limit: Appropriate likelihood family and tail behavior still require empirical checking.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md section 2; 11-S01

scenario: A model upgrade adds iTransformer future-feature tokens while panel granularity expands and DeepAR sample count also rises for tail estimates.
mechanism: Cross-variable attention memory and recursive sampling time exceed the refresh budget; stale outputs look current or retries retrain inside a user request.
detection: Measure peak memory, sample count, panel dimensions, feature-token count, cutoff age and deadline failures.
response: Bound forecasting job resources; precompute immutable artifacts; preserve last result with its true cutoff or return a validated fallback/unavailable state.
test_assertion: Proposed: forced deadline/OOM failure cannot publish a forecast with the current cutoff unless a current result was actually produced; measured spending stays usable.
residual_limit: Tail precision and latency tradeoffs require hardware measurements; no cost benchmark was run here.
owner: Forecasting serving and frontend freshness owners
requirement_source: docs/frontend-plan.md unavailable-forecast requirements; 11-S01, 11-S18

scenario: t0-beta weights load in an older alpha-only runtime without an error; outputs remain numerically plausible.
mechanism: Normalization convention ignored silently.
detection: Validate runtime minimum and checkpoint config conventions before loading; compare pinned reference fixture.
response: Reject unsupported combination and preserve last qualified forecast.
test_assertion: An older runtime/config mismatch never reaches a successful forecast status even if finite values are produced.
residual_limit: A matching version does not establish calibration or numerical parity across accelerators.
requirement_source: Master plan §§2–3; t0-beta official card

scenario: Operator upgrades Toto 1 to 2 for reported accuracy while a staffing-ramp future feature remains configured.
mechanism: New major version currently lacks exogenous-variable support despite older version having it.
detection: Resolve capability by checkpoint+adapter version; required-feature schema comparison.
response: Keep eligible old version or choose qualified alternative; never silently discard feature.
test_assertion: Upgrade with unsupported required future covariates fails validation or exposes an explicitly history-only scenario.
residual_limit: Supported covariates can still be uninformative or misleading.
requirement_source: Master plan context-to-forecast handoff; Toto current repository

scenario: Batch scheduler combines research, product and another tenant or changes batch size while keeping request data unchanged.
mechanism: Cross-learning/group attention uses batch membership as model input, altering forecasts or leaking cross-tenant signal.
detection: Persist grouping IDs/membership; reject cross-tenant groups; invariance tests for independent batching.
response: Make semantic groups explicit and stable; separate tenant workloads; backtest grouped variants.
test_assertion: Independent forecasts invariant to unrelated batch entries; joint forecast includes auditable group membership and never another tenant.
residual_limit: Within-tenant groups may exhibit negative transfer after reorganization.
requirement_source: Master plan team scope; Chronos-2 pipeline warning

scenario: Apache wrapper downloads TimesFM 3 or current Moirai weights into an enterprise production worker; Timestral customer crosses revenue threshold.
mechanism: Code license confused with weights license, or model eligibility changes with organization/deployment conditions.
detection: Registry stores separate license identifiers, license snapshot and deployment eligibility, with no wrapper inheritance.
response: Block ineligible deployment; use a qualified model/service or obtain separate permitted terms.
test_assertion: Apache code alone cannot qualify restrictive weights; eligibility checks cover the actual model artifact and use mode.
residual_limit: Rights for historical copies or custom contracts require their own evidence.
requirement_source: Master plan enterprise product objective; official TimesFM, Moirai, Timestral license sources

scenario: Finance asks for month-remainder P90; model returns 9 or 21 daily quantiles and implementation sums daily P90. A daily expected-spend path is separately filled from the median or simple average of reported quantiles.
mechanism: Marginal quantile addition discards temporal/cross-team dependence; extreme tails may be interpolated/extrapolated. A finite marginal quantile grid also does not identify the expected mean.
detection: Output contract states marginal versus joint samples; prohibit unsupported quantile arithmetic. Declare native point statistic and mean availability/derivation assumptions.
response: Use qualified aggregate-distribution method or label an uncalibrated scenario; preserve native quantile grid and tail method. A mean-dependent path must use a qualified mean estimator and preserve its integration, sample and tail assumptions.
test_assertion: Cumulative risk output cannot be marked calibrated solely from a sum of per-step quantiles. A median or arbitrary quantile-grid average cannot be labeled expected spend without a qualified derivation.
residual_limit: Correct sample aggregation still needs dependence and aggregate calibration.
requirement_source: Master plan supported uncertainty handoff; model output contracts

scenario: A delayed launch plan is supplied as known future staffing while backtest uses the final approved document or actual future usage proxy.
mechanism: Hindsight features make an ordinary forecast resemble GIFT-Eval-CTX oracle effects.
detection: Feature knowledge-time <= forecast origin; feature evidence snapshot; identify oracle versus predicted covariate.
response: Treat unconfirmed plans as scenarios; evaluate event occurrence separately and use as-of documents.
test_assertion: Replacing a document after origin cannot alter the stored historical forecast or its backtest inputs.
residual_limit: Even timestamp-safe plans can fail or lack measured spend effects.
requirement_source: Master plan superseded-plan example; GIFT-Eval-CTX scope

scenario: BigQuery alias silently stays at default 2.5; app claims multivariate 3, ignores longer history, and projects preview pricing after Dec 1.
mechanism: Service limits/defaults/pricing differ from local research family and change over time.
detection: Explicit service model parameter and limits; response metadata; pricing effective dates.
response: Pin/select supported model, expose truncation, re-estimate cost before pricing transition.
test_assertion: Request logs identify selected model; >2048 context for 3 reports truncation; cost estimates carry effective date.
residual_limit: Preview service and commercial terms may change before implementation.
requirement_source: Master plan periods/assumptions; BigQuery AI.FORECAST reference

scenario: New team has two reported days and 28 absent days; zero fill or batch padding resembles a dormant team followed by a spike.
mechanism: Absence, pre-existence padding, actual zero and reporting delay collapse into one numeric pattern.
detection: Separate creation date, observation mask, padding mask and source completeness; effective-history check.
response: Choose qualified short-history forecast, peer prior/scenario or unavailable; do not pretend zero-shot means history-free.
test_assertion: Missing and pre-existence cells never become observed zeros; confidence status reflects actual usable history.
residual_limit: No reviewed model guarantees reliable zero-history spend inference.
requirement_source: Master plan measured/estimated/completeness boundaries; t0 mask contract

scenario: TimeGPT sample request is split across batches for scale and downstream treats concatenated paths as company-wide jointly coupled samples.
mechanism: Partitioning breaks cross-series coupling; same sample_id alone does not establish joint dependence.
detection: Persist service coupled flag and partition manifest; assert joint requirement before dispatch.
response: Use permitted unpartitioned joint request or explicitly model/calibrate dependence elsewhere.
test_assertion: Partitioned uncoupled paths cannot receive a joint-company probability label.
residual_limit: Coupled=true does not prove correct correlations in enterprise data.
requirement_source: Master plan company/team forecast handoff; current Nixtla simulate client

scenario: Moirai2 adapter accepts multivariate dimensions and covariate arguments, so integration marks it fully supported without a shape/capability check.
mechanism: Public source carries univariate-only and multivariate-untested notes despite broader-looking parameters.
detection: Document evidence tier; exercise independent target/feature perturbation and alignment fixtures before qualification.
response: Keep univariate qualified scope or mark unsupported until verified; no silent reshape.
test_assertion: A registry entry cannot claim tested multivariate behavior based solely on constructor arguments.
residual_limit: Passing functional fixtures does not establish predictive value.
requirement_source: Master plan supported-scenario contract; Uni2TS moirai2 forecast source

scenario: A research expansion was approved before the origin, postponed afterward, and the latest document has overwritten the old revision.
mechanism: A current summary retroactively removes the old plan from a historical backtest or leaks the later postponement.
detection: Audit source-version availability and assertion system-time intervals against origin; check snapshot hashes.
response: Replay only eligible versions; retain separate current corrected view and original forecast record; flag unavailable historical versions.
test_assertion: At the earlier origin the forecast sees the approved expansion and not the later postponement; after the change it sees both provenance and the supersession.
residual_limit: Sources without version history cannot support an honest historical deployed-system replay.
owner: Backend context ingestion; Factory assertions; forecasting evaluation
requirement_source: Master plan §2 superseding research example and §4 versioned context; Factory context boundary

scenario: An approved evaluation push says next sprint, while staffing approval is pending and the sprint calendar changed after publication.
mechanism: Approval is converted to certain execution on a falsely precise current-calendar date.
detection: Check separate approval/execution states, dependency claims, relative-date reference version and date precision.
response: Preserve unresolved interval and dependency; expose delayed/on-time scenarios unless empirically calibrated execution model exists.
test_assertion: Approval alone never sets executed=true or event_probability=1; changing today’s calendar does not alter old resolved dates.
residual_limit: Even correct approval and calendar evidence cannot establish future completion.
requirement_source: Factory distinguishes approved plans, informal suggestions and cancelled projects; master §2

scenario: The same research launch is forwarded into three team channels, each with a different project alias, while all use the same evaluation staff.
mechanism: Duplicates become independent events/corroboration and additive work exceeding shared capacity.
detection: Track quoted-parent IDs, semantic event aliases and overlapping staff/workload dependencies.
response: Canonicalize one event with multiple references and affected teams; preserve capacity-coupled scenarios; retain truly independent evidence.
test_assertion: Adding forwarded copies leaves event count, execution weight and total incremental scenario unchanged; independent distinct projects remain distinct.
residual_limit: Undocumented shared-resource constraints may remain unknown.
owner: Backend provenance; Factory entity resolution; forecasting effects
requirement_source: Master team/project context; transcript firm-wide communications hypothesis

scenario: A newer informal message delays a product launch but an approved plan retains the research-evaluation schedule in the same document.
mechanism: Latest-wins resolution erases all prior fields or treats informal discussion as authoritative cancellation.
detection: Compare supersession claim scope, author authority, modality and explicit references; surface conflicting evidence.
response: Supersede only supported fields; retain unresolved alternatives for remaining dates and claims.
test_assertion: Launch timing changes only when supported; unrelated evaluation facts survive; recency alone cannot set approved status.
residual_limit: Authority may be genuinely unclear and require review.
requirement_source: Master approved/newer superseding example and Factory conflicting-date requirement

scenario: An evaluation push has already raised observed tokens; a plan also announces a cheaper model migration with uncertain contract applicability.
mechanism: Forecast adds the entire planned workload again and assumes public pricing applies to all tokens.
detection: Compare event onset with observed baseline window; separate usage effect, model mix, effective contract price and reported charges.
response: Estimate only incremental effects conditional on existing history; carry price alternatives separately and preserve unknown contract basis.
test_assertion: Replaying the same event after observed execution does not apply a second full uplift; price scenario never rewrites measured usage.
residual_limit: No causal counterfactual is observable for a single event; effects may remain scenario-only.
requirement_source: Master §2 usage/cost distinction and context is not a token multiplier

scenario: A cancellation in a restricted attachment is omitted while many accessible expansion messages rank highly; access is later revoked.
mechanism: Top-k retrieval manufactures one-sided support; stale cached summaries disclose now-ineligible text.
detection: Evaluate decisive cancellation recall, version-chain/attachment expansion and permission-filtered cache dependency invalidation.
response: Represent coverage gaps; check authorization on evidence use and display; do not treat inaccessible evidence as absence of cancellation.
test_assertion: An authorized replay retrieves the decisive cancellation despite distractors; revoked evidence and derivatives are not exposed to unauthorized users.
residual_limit: Authorization boundaries can prevent full truth; forecasts must express limited context coverage.
requirement_source: Backend authorization ownership; master evidence inspection and uncertainty

scenario: A project document embeds instructions to ignore prior constraints, invent high-confidence costs and apply a budget transfer, alongside legitimate plan text.
mechanism: Retrieved evidence is promoted to instructions or action approval.
detection: Adversarial documents; action audit tracing user authorization separately from document content; compare extracted claims with spans.
response: Treat document commands as data; schema-restrict extraction and scope tools; backend requires finance authorization independently.
test_assertion: Document can be quoted or flagged but cannot change permissions, suppress uncertainty or create/apply a budget mutation.
residual_limit: Text-only mitigations cannot certify complete prompt-injection resistance.
requirement_source: Factory scoped tools and finance review; master internal allocation boundary

scenario: Historical documents are eligible by date, but today’s retriever selects them after viewing the target spike and the LLM remembers a public launch outcome.
mechanism: As-of content filtering hides selection lookahead and knowledge contamination.
detection: Freeze retrieval queries before outcomes; compare prospective private holdouts, model-cutoff cohorts, identity/date sensitivity and oracle labels.
response: Keep realized-future effects in explicitly diagnostic oracle lane; prohibit live browsing in replay; log full retrieval/model snapshot.
test_assertion: Ordinary forecast features and selection never read post-origin outcomes; oracle results cannot be reported as deployable accuracy.
residual_limit: Unknown pretraining content prevents definitive contamination certification from dates alone.
requirement_source: Mentor representative-data/backtesting concerns; research brief as-of requirement

scenario: Factory assigns 0.95 confidence to an accurate approved-plan extraction; forecast treats it as execution probability and sums event P90 costs across a shared delayed platform migration.
mechanism: Different probability meanings are conflated and dependent marginal quantiles are added.
detection: Typed confidence fields with calibration provenance; inspect joint dependency scenarios and distribution aggregation.
response: Keep extraction quality distinct; use calibrated execution models or unweighted named scenarios; aggregate joint sample paths when supported.
test_assertion: Extraction confidence cannot enter execution probability without an explicit validated mapping; aggregate P90 is computed from joint totals, never sum of marginal P90s.
residual_limit: Small event samples may not support calibrated joint probabilities.
requirement_source: Master uncertainty; research brief generated confidence and quantile constraints

scenario: A team starts posting detailed weekly plans during an AI-adoption rollout; a model learns message counts and current team names, then is deployed on a quieter team after reorganization.
mechanism: Text availability, adoption trend and entity identity confound learned embedding/event effects.
detection: Time/company/project holdouts; matched shuffled-text and document-volume ablations; effective-dated team mappings; missing-context indicators.
response: Retain numeric/calendar/staffing comparator; require semantic value beyond communication volume; use context-coverage state and fallback.
test_assertion: Semantic model claims are rejected if gains persist with shuffled content alone; old events keep historical attribution after team renaming.
residual_limit: Observational data may not identify causal event effects even when predictive lift is real.
owner: Forecasting evaluation; backend identity history; Factory extraction
requirement_source: Transcript team/individual and firm-wide data hypothesis; master team attribution and coverage

scenario: A cheaper default model is adopted overnight while longer reasoning and more experiments raise billable usage; aggregate spend initially stays flat.
mechanism: Opposing price, mix, and volume effects hide material behavioral change in a single dollar-series detector.
detection: Monitor exact model mix and token categories, active users and calls/session, effective rates, and constant-price usage counterfactuals.
response: Retain component changes and joint continuation scenarios; do not claim no change or automatic savings from a flat total.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: construct offsetting rate and usage changes; component evidence changes while the accounting total stays constant, and the explanation reports unresolved continuation.
residual_limit: Early offsetting behavior cannot identify future demand elasticity or sustained use.
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt: new-model price and adoption challenge; ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 1-2

scenario: A provider export fails during a public model release and team spending appears to collapse.
mechanism: Missing observations align with a plausible contextual explanation, encouraging false attribution to cheaper-model adoption.
detection: Connector health, coverage intervals, raw event counts, freshness, and unaffected comparable scopes.
response: Mark incomplete coverage, suspend affected activity updates, and retain the model-release claim as unconfirmed context.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: remove an export partition while adding a release document; the forecast never converts missing usage to zero or labels the decline as supported substitution.
residual_limit: A simultaneous real decline remains unidentified until independent or recovered evidence arrives.
owner: Backend coverage; forecasting fitness gate; Factory evidence
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; frontend-plan.md unavailable/delayed data

scenario: Late research charges arrive just after a project moves to engineering; an arrival-time chart shows an engineering surge.
mechanism: Receipt time is confused with incurred time and current mapping overwrites historical ownership.
detection: Event/received timestamps, charge revision lineage and effective-dated team mappings.
response: Revise the appropriate historical financial basis, replay affected model state, and retain as-of forecast evidence.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: backfill pre-transfer activity after transfer; no new present-period activity break is learned merely from arrival, and totals reconcile under the explicitly chosen ownership basis.
residual_limit: Provider records without service dates or ownership history require unresolved attribution.
owner: Backend temporal ledger and mapping; forecasting replay
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt delayed-bill example; ai-spend-master-plan.md section 4

scenario: A tool-schema deployment invalidates reusable prompt prefixes; cache writes and input overhead jump, then cache warms and costs recover.
mechanism: A temporary configuration-driven pulse resembles a permanent workload regime shift.
detection: Prompt/schema versions, cache-category meters, tool tokens and comparable task volume over warm-up and recovery.
response: Compare pulse, step and reversible-state candidates; retain actual financial exposure even if the long-run activity model stays stable.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: inject a cache-miss pulse followed by recovery at unchanged workload; no irreversible full-history deletion occurs, and pulse costs remain included in incurred estimates.
residual_limit: Unlogged configuration changes may remain causally unresolved.
owner: Backend meter/configuration evidence; forecasting intervention response
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md distinguish usage/cost and preserve assumptions; 14-S11

scenario: A company enables a new default tool for every developer in one day, then disables it after a short trial.
mechanism: A monotonic slow diffusion model cannot represent a centralized switch, initial exploration, and abandonment.
detection: Eligibility/default-setting effective dates, distinct activation and active-use counts, per-user intensity and rollout cancellation evidence.
response: Offer immediate-switch and reversal candidates; preserve previous regime state and avoid treating seats as guaranteed use.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: daily step-up then reversal is representable without an enforced minimum rollout duration; forecast scenarios retain access/use distinction.
residual_limit: Usage after a short trial may not identify steady-state adoption.
owner: Forecasting adoption/scenario model; backend settings; Factory context
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt adoption-delay challenge; internal-team-discussion.txt new tools; 14-S10

scenario: A team moves work from a monitored API to self-hosted inference while a narrative claims the model is free.
mechanism: Observed vendor charges fall but GPU, hosting, operations or other commitments are outside the target scope.
detection: Migration/configuration context, declining monitored task share, coverage registry and separately evidenced hosting costs where available.
response: Forecast monitored charges on their stated basis; label all-in cost unavailable or partial and create a separate migration-cost scenario if inputs exist.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: zero monitored API charges after migration cannot produce a supported zero all-in AI-cost claim.
residual_limit: Complete economic cost cannot be recovered from absent billing categories.
owner: Backend target coverage; forecasting scope; Factory explanation
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt cheaper/open-source substitution challenge; ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 1-2

scenario: An adaptive ensemble promotes a model using incomplete 30-day outcomes while late charges favor a different contender.
mechanism: Premature labels, mixed forecast origins, and double-counted revisions corrupt online losses and weight updates.
detection: Outcome maturity status, forecast-origin keys, available-at timestamps and revision-aware score lineage.
response: Keep pending losses, use a declared provisional/final target policy and revise each outcome contribution exactly once.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: withheld charges cannot influence earlier weights; the same finalized outcome and revision affect the appropriate score without duplicate training contribution.
residual_limit: Rapid changes can outpace final feedback even with correct accounting.
owner: Forecasting evaluation and online updates; backend revisions
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt delayed billing; ai-spend-master-plan.md evidence boundaries; 14-S08

scenario: A legitimate very expensive evaluation job is statistically isolated, and a robust detector discounts it as an outlier.
mechanism: Robust distribution estimation is confused with permission to ignore incurred exposure or budget risk.
detection: Separate absolute cost/exposure checks, job evidence and recurring-project context from regime detector output.
response: Include the incurred job, explain continuation uncertainty and compare one-off versus recurring scenarios regardless of the change alarm.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: suppressing a regime alert never removes a valid charge or its budget-threshold impact; recurring follow-up jobs can support a later adaptation.
residual_limit: A single large event cannot establish its recurrence probability.
owner: Forecasting risk channel; backend ledger; frontend explanation
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md variable usage and accounting distinction; 14-S12

scenario: Research pauses evaluation after a finance warning, resumes next period, and repeats this pattern; the internal allocation itself does not enforce provider usage.
mechanism: Human behavioral feedback and project cycles produce recurring regimes that a permanent reset or budget-as-hard-cap assumption misreads.
detection: Project/calendar and communication evidence, actual observed resumption, and separation of internal budgets from provider limits.
response: Preserve recurrent experts and conditional resume scenarios; do not truncate spend at an internal allocation.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: observed spend can exceed allocation; a temporary pause does not force zero future spend, and prior recurring-state evidence remains retrievable.
residual_limit: Finance action is endogenous to forecasts; causal policy effects need more than correlation.
owner: Forecasting regimes and scenario semantics; Factory context
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 1 and 3 internal-only allocations; 14-S04

scenario: A stable company has many correlated small-team streams while two teams undergo opposite real shifts that cancel in company totals.
mechanism: Per-stream thresholds accumulate false alerts; company-only monitoring masks localized changes and allocation risk.
detection: Stable-cohort residuals, team and company component views, shared-source incident grouping and empirical fleet alarm counts.
response: Calibrate an organization-level operational alarm budget, group common incidents, and retain team-level evidence without summing detector probabilities.
test_assertion: PROPOSED: stable correlated replay reports observed fleet false alarms separately from nominal delta; opposite team shifts remain visible despite unchanged company spend.
residual_limit: Sparse teams may have low power; dependence weakens naive multiple-test calculations.
owner: Forecasting detector/evaluation design; backend shared-source metadata
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md company/team planning; mentor-discussion.txt team-specific change; 14-S02 and 14-S03

scenario: Research and engineering share an evaluation burst, but samples are drawn independently by team and day.
mechanism: Marginal distributions remain plausible while common-tail company-period risk is erased.
detection: Compare cross-team/cross-date residual dependence and shared-burst event scores; verify path IDs survive transformations.
response: Use aligned joint residual blocks or a qualified dependence model; withhold company risk if unsupported.
test_assertion: Construct two $100/p=0.1 teams: independence gives P(total>150)=0.01, perfect co-burst gives 0.10; aggregator preserves assigned joint law.
residual_limit: Observed correlations cannot identify a never-seen shared extreme.
requirement_source: master plan §3 projections handoff; frontend §company/team overview

scenario: Two mostly zero days each show a daily p95 of zero and the UI adds p95 values.
mechanism: Quantiles do not commute with temporal or entity summation.
detection: Inspect whether period quantiles are computed from period distributions/complete paths rather than displayed component quantiles.
response: Aggregate each path or fit/calibrate the total directly.
test_assertion: Two independent $100 bursts each with p=.04 have daily p95=0 and two-day p95=100; total is not zero.
residual_limit: Even correct aggregation inherits the path model assumptions.
requirement_source: master plan §3 supported uncertainty; frontend financial meaning acceptance

scenario: Twenty daily forecasts of one month end are treated as twenty independent calibrated monthly outcomes.
mechanism: Repeated targets and overlapping sums inflate apparent calibration sample size and precision.
detection: Track target-period IDs, overlap matrix, distinct mature periods and evaluation clustering.
response: Preserve all forecast rows but report dependent evidence and group evaluation uncertainty by target/origin structure.
test_assertion: Duplicating origins for an unchanged terminal target does not increase distinct-target count or narrow an IID evidence interval.
residual_limit: Nonoverlapping periods may still share regimes.
requirement_source: master plan forecast research TBDs; original transcript weekly/monthly comparison

scenario: A long 30-day horizon is recalibrated tomorrow using a partially settled invoice.
mechanism: Incomplete target is mislabeled as a low-spend final outcome, causing downward interval adaptation.
detection: Pending-score queue keyed by target end, financial basis, maturity and truth version.
response: Update only when declared target maturity is met; keep provisional evaluation separately.
test_assertion: Partial invoice does not complete a mature-total residual or update that target calibrator; mature arrival updates it once.
residual_limit: Maturity rules may miss later corrections.
requirement_source: backend coverage/origin requirements; frontend delayed data cannot become zero

scenario: Provider restates a large burst after an ACI update and the new invoice triggers a second update.
mechanism: One outcome is counted twice; calibrator state depends on connector retry order.
detection: Version each outcome and maintain consumed-score/update ledger.
response: Replace evidence through deterministic replay or a justified versioned correction; retain operational and restated metrics.
test_assertion: Replaying identical source revisions produces same final calibration state; forecast artifact remains immutable.
residual_limit: Replay policy itself needs validation after historical revisions.
requirement_source: backend idempotency and history acceptance

scenario: High-spend bursts take longer to settle, while calibration includes only quickly settled normal days.
mechanism: Complete-case selection changes the score distribution and hides the right tail.
detection: Compare reported/mature delay by spend/activity strata; expose outstanding coverage and value estimates.
response: Evaluate delay-aware nowcast and maturity policies; degrade risk availability when pending coverage is material.
test_assertion: Synthetic delayed-burst fixture shows missing targets as pending, never zero, and qualification checks see selection imbalance.
residual_limit: Unreported activity cannot be fully quantified without another signal.
requirement_source: master plan measured/estimated coverage; backend source completeness

scenario: Eighteen calibration scores are used to claim a finite unrestricted 95% split-conformal bound; infinities are capped to fit a chart.
mechanism: Rank exceeds calibration size and UI capping silently destroys the stated construction.
detection: Check finite-sample rank, boundary alpha and infinite interval status before serialization.
response: Return unbounded/insufficient-evidence state and keep point/actual values if available.
test_assertion: At n=18 and alpha=.05 rank=19; no finite empirical rank is substituted; infinite bounds do not serialize as zero.
residual_limit: Nineteen scores permit a finite bound but do not prove practical accuracy or independence.
requirement_source: master plan supported uncertainty/unavailable handoff

scenario: A nonnegative gross-spend forecast is reused for net charges after a refund and cumulative paths are forcibly monotone.
mechanism: Financial-basis mismatch removes legitimate negative revisions and can falsely mark overspend certain.
detection: Carry gross/net and component basis through model/forecast/budget comparison; detect negative charge categories.
response: Separate gross usage and credits or use a net model with appropriate support; reconcile once.
test_assertion: A refund fixture is retained in net totals; gross-model support checks do not overwrite the refund or declare terminal exceedance certain.
residual_limit: Future discretionary credits can remain unpredictable.
requirement_source: master plan fixed/included/variable distinction and financial unit requirements

scenario: An approved research launch has 0.9 extraction confidence and is presented as 90% probability of an expensive launch.
mechanism: Semantic confidence is substituted for event probability; scenario weights fabricate a predictive mixture.
detection: Require distinct provenance for scenario occurrence weights, extraction confidence and conditional spend distributions.
response: Return scenario-conditioned totals; leave unconditional risk unavailable when weights are unknown.
test_assertion: Changing extraction confidence alone never changes numeric scenario occurrence weights or unconditional spend probability.
residual_limit: Approved plans can still be cancelled; defensible weights may never be available.
requirement_source: Factory plans versus guaranteed events; no invented numerical multipliers

scenario: A new provider/project is compared with a heavily recency-weighted residual pool containing no extreme bursts.
mechanism: Small effective support plus changed conditional law makes narrow weighted intervals look adapted while tail mass disappears.
detection: Report weight concentration, mature-tail counts, provider/project shift and subgroup coverage; test shared-burst scenarios.
response: Compare broader pooling, explicit tail challengers and unweighted stress cases; qualify or withhold tail probability.
test_assertion: Fixture with identical ordinary marginals and a new shared-burst regime triggers an unsupported-tail state despite many Monte Carlo draws.
residual_limit: No retrospective estimator identifies unannounced paradigm changes reliably.
requirement_source: master plan no claim to predict every adoption change; frontend uncertain outcomes

scenario: A costly request starts shortly before month end, pauses for a long test, then resumes next month; its final usage counter arrives late.
mechanism: Assigning eventual task severity to start date or treating late reported usage as future continuation advances or duplicates spending across finance periods.
detection: Preserve occurrence interval, source reporting convention, observed-at timestamp, request start and state transitions; compare accrued and reported-time views.
response: Forecast only increments inside the target interval; keep late-incurred nowcast separate; expose ambiguous occurrence intervals instead of inventing uniform accrual.
test_assertion: For a deterministic fixture with dated invocation increments, month totals sum to the lifetime total with each invocation counted once; late arrival changes observed completeness but not the documented occurrence-time assignment.
residual_limit: A provider that supplies only completion timestamps cannot support exact within-call accrual without an explicit convention.
owner: Backend usage normalization and forecasting target owner
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; mentor-discussion.txt lines 74-81; 16-S02

scenario: A session remains open overnight awaiting the human; on return it incurs a large uncached prefix under a changed cache policy.
mechanism: Open-session count is mistaken for continuous token production, while the resumed-request severity model assumes a warm cache.
detection: Separate human-wait intervals from model-running state; record preceding gap, cached/uncached usage and known cache-policy/version metadata.
response: Use state-dependent resumption and resource marks; treat a new user task as an arrival in an existing context, not continuous autonomous work.
test_assertion: An observed waiting interval contributes no fabricated model usage; resumed invocation uses its actual cache category and is assigned once regardless of whether conversation ID persists.
residual_limit: Cache eviction is often externally unobserved; a gap is a predictive feature, not proof of a specific retention rule.
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md section 2; 16-S02 and 16-S04

scenario: Context compacts while the local cumulative counter resets after a runtime restart, and the source re-emits the last pre-restart event.
mechanism: Context shrinkage becomes negative incurred usage, a reset delta becomes zero or a giant positive jump, or the replayed event duplicates spending.
detection: Keep context length separate from cumulative resource counters, persist counter epoch and event identity, and flag decreasing cumulative counters.
response: Normalize usage within validated counter epochs; quarantine ambiguous reset gaps; represent compaction as a state change with any separately observed summarizer usage.
test_assertion: Compaction never reduces already-incurred usage; replay is idempotent; known post-reset increments remain countable without silently assuming missing pre-reset usage was zero.
residual_limit: Unlogged reset boundaries can leave a bounded or unknown increment rather than an exact value.
requirement_source: backend-plan.md acceptance checks; ai-spend-master-plan.md repeated cumulative counter warning; 16-S07

scenario: A user forks a conversation with copied historical telemetry, retries a failed request on another machine, and both branches execute new model calls.
mechanism: Shared history is billed twice or legitimate retry work is deduplicated merely because task text matches; independent roots inflate human arrival counts.
detection: Retain invocation/source IDs, machine/source namespaces, lineage and inherited-event metadata; distinguish semantic task identity from physical execution identity.
response: Deduplicate copied historical invocations only; count genuinely distinct billable executions; preserve related-branch groups for evaluation and dependence modeling.
test_assertion: Forked historical events have one incurred total, while new child and retry invocations all remain in totals; train/test splits keep known related branches together.
residual_limit: Without provider invocation IDs or lineage, exact overlap may be unresolved; do not merge based only on similar text.
requirement_source: backend-plan.md idempotent ingestion; master plan explicit attribution; 16-S04 session-linkage limitation

scenario: One person starts several requests before a deadline; shared provider quotas queue or reject calls and automatic retries resume after the forecast boundary.
mechanism: Summing unconstrained session rate forecasts overstates near-term usage and underestimates later retry bursts; active session count conflates waiting and execution.
detection: Capture running/waiting states, rejection reason, retry events and known shared quota scope; inspect overlapping intervals and completion delays.
response: Condition near-term continuation on observed capacity state where available; simulate shared delay shocks rather than independent request timelines; retain a quota-unknown scenario.
test_assertion: A fixture with queued nonbillable requests produces no invented model tokens until invocation; distinct billable retry calls are counted and timed correctly.
residual_limit: Undisclosed provider queues and unreported failed-call charging prevent exact pre-call cost timing.
owner: Session state and forecast simulation owners
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md future projection assumptions; 16-S02 timing evidence

scenario: The telemetry collector crashes disproportionately on very long expensive sessions; coverage begins mid-request for replacement machines.
mechanism: Closed-only training overrepresents short cheap runs; unknown initial ages become zero; coverage loss is misclassified as successful termination.
detection: Maintain independent collector coverage and heartbeat state, end-reason provenance, last-observed event, known or unknown start age, and unresolved terminal statuses. Check distinct source capabilities for daily totals, session summaries, identified prefixes, live state and availability provenance, plus freshness.
response: Represent right censoring, left truncation and unknown age separately; compare complete-case results to missingness sensitivity scenarios; fall back to aggregates when linkage is unreliable. Aggregates/finalized summaries alone cannot enable live continuation; failed coverage/freshness gates select the daily fallback.
test_assertion: A collector-loss record remains unknown/censored rather than completed with zero future usage; restarting observation does not reset known request age or duplicate prior increments. An aggregate-only source or stale snapshot cannot activate the live continuation model.
residual_limit: Informative censoring may remain unidentifiable without an independent billing source; survival-model assumptions must be reported.
requirement_source: frontend-plan.md missing data must not become zero; 16-S08

scenario: An evaluation uses task category inferred from final logs, final success status, or realized future model mix at an early prefix; sibling prefixes appear in training. A normalized round starts before a cutoff but its tool result and token_count report arrive after it.
mechanism: The estimator receives future behavior and related outcomes that would not exist at forecast time, overstating usable accuracy. Filtering by earliest round timestamp exposes final usage, result size/status and tool latency before those fields exist.
detection: Require available-at timestamps for all features, preserve extraction version and source cutoff, and group related request/fork IDs before splitting. Track field-level supporting report/result events, CLI/turn-ID behavior, pinned dataset release and extractor/schema.
response: Recompute features from truncated source prefixes; use future unknown covariates only as explicit scenarios; keep all prefixes of a request in the same partition. Mask final usage and result-derived fields until supporting events; preserve original ingestion times where available. Otherwise label event-time prefix simulation, not original arrival/source-delay replay.
test_assertion: Changing suffix events after the forecast cutoff cannot change the stored prefix feature vector or prediction inputs; a grouped split contains no shared request lineage. At a cutoff between tool emission and later result/usage report, tool request is visible but final usage, result status/size and latency are absent; re-normalization cannot reveal them retrospectively.
residual_limit: Unknown cross-account retries and semantic duplicates can still leak correlated tasks across groups. Event timestamps alone cannot reconstruct original ingestion delays.
requirement_source: Forecast research boundary and evidence standard; 16-S08 and 16-S06; 16-S03 README data format; r04 telemetry cross-review

scenario: A user changes model, reasoning effort and permission mode mid-session while a harness update changes compaction behavior; the export labels the whole session using its final model.
mechanism: Historical usage is repriced with the wrong model and future severity uses an obsolete workflow regime; missing effort is silently interpreted as low effort.
detection: Prefer step-level model/configuration events and versioned alias mapping; compare session summary labels against per-invocation metadata and track unknown feature values.
response: Split configuration epochs while retaining session lineage; apply time-valid rates by invocation; widen uncertainty or use pooled fallback for unseen regimes.
test_assertion: Earlier invocations retain original model/rate after a later switch; absent effort remains unknown; a change in config is reflected only from its observed effective point onward.
residual_limit: Some products hide routing or effort; a single opaque plan label cannot identify the real execution configuration.
owner: Usage contract, pricing and session feature owners
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt lines 102-115; ai-spend-master-plan.md usage versus cost distinction; 16-S01 and 16-S07

scenario: A production incident simultaneously increases request arrivals, expensive debugging severity, retries and cross-team concurrency, then subsides after mitigation.
mechanism: Independent count/severity forecasts and independent team sampling miss tail risk; a Hawkes model mistakes the common incident for persistent self-excitation.
detection: Inspect conditional severity versus count, residual cross-team correlation and known incident timing using only available evidence; compare common-shock and excitation models.
response: Use joint count/mark or shared calendar-shock simulations and scenario conditioning; evaluate a non-exciting baseline; derive aggregate quantiles from joint sampled totals.
test_assertion: Synthetic dependent fixtures distinguish E[sum severity|N] from independent mean multiplication; summed sample paths reproduce dependence and do not use sums of marginal quantiles as company quantiles.
residual_limit: Unannounced incidents remain unpredictable; correct dependence representation does not guarantee accurate incident arrival forecasts.
requirement_source: Master plan company/team forecasts with limitations; 16-S09; coordination with track 07

scenario: An additive hybrid combines a daily total forecast with full unfinished-request continuation; the daily target already contains that continuation, while a late provider correction overlaps telemetry.
mechanism: Unfinished-work usage and late-incurred observations are counted in multiple components, biasing totals upward despite individually calibrated component forecasts.
detection: Define request-start and occurrence-time partitions at each forecast cutoff; audit target provenance, observed invocation keys and component ownership.
response: Active component predicts only future increments from requests started by the cutoff; arrival component predicts increments from later starts; late-incurred nowcast is disjoint. Keep daily totals as standalone comparator or feature-enriched model if partition is unavailable.
test_assertion: For a fixture with an ongoing request, a future request and a late usage correction, each covered increment belongs to exactly one component; component totals reconcile to the target and cannot add full continuation to a total-demand baseline.
residual_limit: Unidentified request starts or uncertain occurrence intervals may prevent an exact partition; disable the additive hybrid rather than assume disjointness.
owner: Forecast target, reconciliation and hybrid model owners
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md observed/forecast distinctions; 16 target formula; r04 telemetry cross-review

scenario: A retroactively dated research cancellation and corrected provider bill arrive after the forecast origin, but a current-state backtest uses both.
mechanism: Event date is mistaken for availability date; revised context and charges make history appear easier than deployment.
detection: Compare input manifest against immutable ingestion/publication/version availability; perturb later revisions and compare the earlier snapshot hash.
response: Replay only versions visible at the origin; retain later outcomes solely in the versioned label store.
test_assertion: Proposed test: adding a later document or bill revision leaves every earlier forecast input snapshot and issued result unchanged while updating only eligible label vintages.
residual_limit: Historical snapshots absent from the source cannot be recovered faithfully; mark replay eligibility unknown rather than reconstruct certainty.
requirement_source: Master plan spending/context evidence; backend distinct versions; internal transcript rolling backtests

scenario: High-spend teams have longer invoice delays, so only quiet teams have settled labels when a candidate is scored.
mechanism: Complete-case scoring selects easy cases and implicitly converts pending labels into non-events.
detection: Scheduled-origin ledger reconciles mature, pending, disputed and missing labels; compare origin-known spend/coverage across label states.
response: Publish maturity coverage and delay strata, wait for declared settlement or report restricted support; keep residual revision sensitivity.
test_assertion: Proposed test: delaying high-spend labels reduces reported label coverage without changing pending labels to zero or claiming full-population superiority.
residual_limit: Unknown outcomes prevent a definitive full-population accuracy estimate; weighting cannot identify missing-not-at-random labels without additional assumptions.
requirement_source: Master plan coverage and unavailable states; backend incomplete data acceptance checks

scenario: Daily 30-day forecasts for many teams all capture the same company-wide evaluation burst, creating thousands of apparently independent successes.
mechanism: Overlapping target windows, shared horizon outcomes and common company shocks collapse effective independent support.
detection: Report distinct companies, settled periods, non-overlapping blocks and episodes alongside raw rows; inspect loss-difference dependence.
response: Use paired company/time-block uncertainty with block sensitivity and per-company results; qualify unsupported population inference.
test_assertion: Proposed test: duplicating teams or shifting overlapping origins cannot increase distinct company/event support or produce an iid-row confidence claim.
residual_limit: Few independent companies or events can leave uncertainty large even with extensive time series.
requirement_source: Master plan company/team scope and no invented accuracy claims

scenario: An unseen company is a rebranded subsidiary of a training tenant, and its workload also appears under a shared API project.
mechanism: Entity identifiers differ while underlying labels/documents are duplicated, defeating a nominal leave-company-out split.
detection: Split-lineage audit of export hashes, provider-account lineage, organizational relationships and document duplication under authorized access.
response: Group dependent entities before population splitting; quarantine ambiguous provenance from cold-company claims.
test_assertion: Proposed test: aliases and shared workload exports must remain in one split group, with no held-out-derived fitted features in training.
residual_limit: Undisclosed commercial relationships or foundation-model pretraining exposure may remain unknown.
owner: Evaluation, tenant data governance and pooling
requirement_source: Master plan explicit attribution and company evidence; authorized pooling constraint

scenario: A configuration agent repeatedly reads final-window scores, changes prompts and weights, and reports only its best seed after many costly failed trials.
mechanism: Adaptive test reuse, hidden search budget and seed selection turn final evaluation into tuning.
detection: Evaluation-access logs, immutable candidate/search manifests, full trial ledger and seed registry.
response: Restrict search to development; evaluate the complete locked selector once on final data, account for all costs and require a new final window after redesign.
test_assertion: Proposed test: an attempted final-label read during search is denied or marks the evaluation contaminated; all failed trials remain in cost accounting.
residual_limit: Human researchers can also adapt to remembered final summaries; technical access controls alone do not repair organizational test reuse.
requirement_source: Factory forecasting setup is research-dependent; no universal architecture claim

scenario: A manager's annual budget request in internal credits is treated as a monthly expected-dollar forecast, then corrected downward using later revised actuals.
mechanism: Target/function/unit mismatch and unavailable labels create a spurious personal overforecast-bias finding.
detection: Require forecast purpose, unit conversion, target interval, point functional, original timestamp and settled-pair availability before comparison.
response: Exclude incomparable entries from predictive bias estimation while retaining audit evidence; compare only matched forecasts and shrink weak corrections.
test_assertion: Proposed test: a budget request cannot enter manager MAE/bias evaluation without an explicit predictive-target mapping; future revisions cannot train earlier corrections.
residual_limit: Even comparable forecasts may reflect changed incentives or selective submission; predictive evidence is not a personnel assessment.
requirement_source: Internal transcript manager historical-bias idea; master plan unit distinctions and internal allocation semantics

scenario: A warning prompts finance to add internal funds, after which the benchmark relabels the original warning as a false alarm because the revised budget was not breached.
mechanism: Post-forecast budget changes alter the target event and confound warning evaluation with decisions.
detection: Compare breach labels against budget version captured in each origin manifest; trace later funding decisions separately.
response: Score the original threshold event; evaluate decision outcomes in a separate versioned policy analysis without asserting provider-spend savings.
test_assertion: Proposed test: increasing the later envelope does not change the origin-specific event label or erase the first-warning lead time.
residual_limit: If decisions change actual usage behavior, causal no-intervention outcomes remain unobserved and need a separate design.
owner: Evaluation, warning policy and budget ledger
requirement_source: Master plan additions versus reallocations; frontend saved budget state and explicit finance decisions

scenario: The candidate returns no forecast during provider outages and expensive bursts, while the baseline forecasts every scheduled case.
mechanism: Conditional accuracy is compared on different denominators; missing/late outputs disappear and the candidate wins by refusing difficult cases.
detection: Reconcile outputs with the immutable schedule and deadline; publish reason-coded availability and shared-case/full-service scores.
response: Evaluate registered fallback and review/delay costs on all scheduled cases; retain conditional accuracy as a separate diagnostic.
test_assertion: Proposed test: removing the worst predictions cannot improve an all-case service score without an explicitly charged abstention/fallback consequence.
residual_limit: Actual review and delay costs must be elicited; without them report a frontier rather than a single utility winner.
owner: Evaluation and forecast API availability policy
requirement_source: Frontend unavailable forecasts remain visible; Factory remains useful without forecast; backend incomplete data

scenario: Daily team intervals appear calibrated, but their quantiles are summed into a company monthly interval while teams share a model-launch shock.
mechanism: Marginal calibration and quantile arithmetic fail to preserve joint dependence or aggregate uncertainty.
detection: Independently score realized cumulative and company targets; compare aggregation construction with joint sample/path contracts.
response: Construct coherent aggregate distributions or calibrate aggregate targets directly; restrict unsupported aggregate-probability claims.
test_assertion: Proposed test: a correlated-shock fixture invalidates naive quantile sums and requires separate cumulative/company scoring before interval promotion.
residual_limit: Synthetic correlated shocks test mechanics, not the real frequency or severity of joint enterprise shocks.
requirement_source: Master plan company/team comparison and supported uncertainty semantics

scenario: The final panel contains only currently active teams; dissolved research teams and canceled projects with large overruns were removed by today's team map.
